algorithm: Focused shared-stock InternVL allocation with balanced causal initialization and factorized episodic RL
validation: 2024 net growth at100000 INR, earliest tie; zero and supervised-only eligible
test_caveat: Retrospective evaluation repeatedly seen by project; method selection is adaptive, not untouched confirmation. Fixed universe has survivorship/selection limitations.
teacher_selection: Mean annual net log growth minus 0.1 drawdown, 2015-2023 only; 2024 not used for anchor selection
SFT: 2015-2022 actual account states,25percent candidate risk-counterfactual augmentation,2048 class-balanced focus examples max. Gate uses2023 real observations only. Check every512 examples; stop at first passing gate. Native one-action readout per focused stock, full other-stock/account context.
RL: Four60-session own-account trajectories per context,two contexts/update,three20-session decisions. Per-stock clipped probability ratios with shared trajectory group advantage;120focus examples/collection,two passes. Reference is gate-passing SFT. Other coefficients unchanged; attentionLR3e-6/headLR3e-5. First72updates with12-check validation patience or configured iterations.
sampling: 2015-2023 RL histories; prior gate year2023 becomes RL training explicitly. 2024 financial validation remains separate. Causal regime buckets; no future-based sampling.
execution: Whole shares, no shorts/leverage, next-open fills,0.10% fee+0.05%slippage each side;35%stock/60%sector caps with affordability relaxation; dividends creditedexdate; splits reconstructed; no tax/marketimpact model.
model: Shared original InternVL3-2B attention/vocabulary LoRA. Five explicit stock-focus prompts with full market/account context; one original-vocabulary action per prompt. Temperature1.0,uniform exploration0.05. No separate numerical policy or action fallback.
selection_limit: No claim of optimum, flawless process, independent unseen test, journal acceptance or universal outperformance. RL gain must be measured separately from SFT.
learning_gate: 2023 balanced accuracy>=0.60 and >=raw+0.15; minimum recall>=0.20 among classes with>=8 cases; >=4 predicted classes. If no pass, stop before RL and no financial test. No guarantee this heuristic-learning gate predicts a trading edge.

recovery.method: weights-only warm restart; original optimizer/RNG were not persisted
